tacz.attachment.bayonet_6h3.desc: 6H3 bayonet. The last resort, and the closest one.
tacz.attachment.bayonet_m9.desc: M9 bayonet. Still makes a point after the ammo runs out.
tacz.attachment.deagle_golden_long_barre: Golden long barrel: it looks good, and it does punch through.
tacz.attachment.extended_mag_1.desc: Tier 1 extended mag. More rounds, slower handling.
tacz.attachment.extended_mag_2.desc: Tier 2 extended mag. Higher capacity, heavier feel.
tacz.attachment.extended_mag_3.desc: Tier 3 extended mag. Most rounds, slowest handling.
tacz.attachment.grip_cobra.desc: SI grip. Faster draw, almost no weight.
tacz.attachment.grip_cqr.desc: Hera Arms CQR. Draw speed and recoil control.
tacz.attachment.grip_magpul_afg_2.desc: Talon AFG handstop. Less pitch, wider spread.
tacz.attachment.grip_osovets_black.desc: P-2 grip. Aimed at horizontal spread.
tacz.attachment.grip_rk0.desc: RK-0 grip. Classic vertical hold for pitch.
tacz.attachment.grip_rk1_b25u.desc: RK-1 B25U: halves your spread, then bills you the draw.
tacz.attachment.grip_rk6.desc: RK-6 grip. A little draw, a little spread.
tacz.attachment.grip_se_5.desc: SE-5 Express grip. Faster draw, mild control.
tacz.attachment.grip_td.desc: TD grip. Tightens spread and aim drift.
tacz.attachment.grip_vertical_military.d: Nagoma standard grip. Recoil control first.
tacz.attachment.grip_vertical_ranger.des: Koch Ranger heavy grip: weighs like a brick, buries the recoil.
tacz.attachment.grip_vertical_talon.desc: Talon SG2 grip. Less pitch, less aim drift.
tacz.attachment.laser_compact.desc: Militech compact laser. A hip-fire and stealth sight.
tacz.attachment.laser_lopro.desc: Lopro tactical laser: weighs like a promise, points like one too.
tacz.attachment.laser_nightstick.desc: Nightstick laser. At night, the enemy sees it first.
tacz.attachment.laser_peq15.desc: PEQ-15 laser module. Tighter hip fire.
tacz.attachment.laser_peq6.desc: PEQ6 ILLM. Stealth, prone fire, headshots included.
tacz.attachment.light_extended_mag_1.des: Light tier 1 mag. Least weight for a slower draw.
tacz.attachment.light_extended_mag_2.des: Light tier 2 mag. More rounds, still carry-light.
tacz.attachment.light_extended_mag_3.des: Light tier 3 mag. Capacity and weight in balance.
tacz.attachment.muzzle_brake_cthulhu.des: Cthulhu K7 brake. Recoil tamed, spread creeps up.
Cyclone D2 brake. For muzzle climb that will not sit down.
Mastiff brake. Bites down on shotgun recoil.
tacz.attachment.muzzle_brake_pioneer.des: Pioneer A3: two thirds of pitch gone, the yaw walks away.
Timeless .50 brake. Built for anti-materiel work.
tacz.attachment.muzzle_brake_trex.desc: T-Rex brake. Kills climb, drift keeps walking.
tacz.attachment.muzzle_choke_sg.desc: Shotgun choke. Tighter pellets, more honest recoil.
tacz.attachment.muzzle_compensator_tride: Tempest Trident. Fixes horizontal drift and nothing else.
tacz.attachment.muzzle_silencer_knight_q: Knight QD. Quiet, and it presses the recoil down.
tacz.attachment.muzzle_silencer_mirage.d: Mirage silencer. Light enough to forget it is a silencer.
tacz.attachment.muzzle_silencer_phantom_: Phantom S1. Sound gone, a little accuracy with it.
tacz.attachment.muzzle_silencer_ptilopsi: PO-2 Ptilopsis: at night the quietest bird is not an owl.
tacz.attachment.muzzle_silencer_sg.desc: 12 Gauge silencer. Makes a shotgun polite.
tacz.attachment.muzzle_silencer_ursus.de: Ursus standard silencer. Sound suppressed, spread is not.
Vulture .50: heaviest thing on the gun, for one dull thud.
tacz.attachment.muzzle_silencer_wraith.d: Wraith silencer. Quiet, and oddly fond of headshots.
tacz.attachment.oem_stock_heavy.desc: Factory heavy stock. Tames recoil, slower handling.
tacz.attachment.oem_stock_light.desc: Factory light stock. Faster handling, weak control.
tacz.attachment.oem_stock_tactical.desc: Factory tactical stock. Balance of speed and control.
tacz.attachment.scope_1873_6x.desc: Vintage Springfield. Six times closer, smells of old oil.
tacz.attachment.scope_98k.desc: Mauser 4x. An old pairing with the 98K.
tacz.attachment.scope_acog_ta31.desc: TA31 ACOG. Fixed 2x; the light comes to you.
tacz.attachment.scope_aug_default.desc: AUG builtin. It lives on the rifle and never leaves.
tacz.attachment.scope_contender.desc: Contender 4x. Clarity built for a single shot.
tacz.attachment.scope_elcan_4x.desc: Elcan 4x. Heavy, but you see everything.
tacz.attachment.scope_hamr.desc: HAMR 3x. Near and far without swapping glass.
tacz.attachment.scope_lpvo_1_6.desc: LPVO 1-6x. One for the room, six for the ridge.
tacz.attachment.scope_mk5hd.desc: Mark 5 HD. Pulls the far side closer.
tacz.attachment.scope_qmk152.desc: QMK-152 3x. White light, clean, no explanations.
tacz.attachment.scope_standard_8x.desc: Scout 4-10x: the heaviest pane of glass on the whole gun.
tacz.attachment.shotgun_extended_mag_1.d: Shotgun tube extension. One more shell before reloading.
tacz.attachment.shotgun_extended_mag_2.d: Shotgun tube extension. Fewer reloads, more pellets.
tacz.attachment.shotgun_extended_mag_3.d: Shotgun tube extension. Longest string of fire.
tacz.attachment.sight_552.desc: Militech 552 HCOG. Wide view; the dot is more honest than iron.
tacz.attachment.sight_acro_pistol.desc: Aimpoint ACRO P-1. Small, quick, no excuses.
tacz.attachment.sight_acro_rifle.desc: ACRO P-1 rised. Works on pistol and rifle.
tacz.attachment.sight_coyote.desc: Coyote sight. Weightless, and the dot comes up fast.
DeltaPoint sight. Faster than thinking about it.
tacz.attachment.sight_deltapoint_rifle.d: DeltaPoint rised. A slightly taller view.
tacz.attachment.sight_exp3.desc: EXP3 HCOG. Clean glass, no arguments.
tacz.attachment.sight_fastfire_pistol.de: FastFire. The name is the manual.
tacz.attachment.sight_fastfire_rifle.des: FastFire rised. Dot on sight, every time.
tacz.attachment.sight_okp7.desc: OKP-7 reflex. No frame, straight Soviet.
tacz.attachment.sight_p90.desc: P90 ring sight. Ring over iron, faster than graduations.
tacz.attachment.sight_p90.name: P90 Ring Reflex Sight
tacz.attachment.sight_pk06_pistol.desc: PK06 sight. Light, tidy, and never slow.
tacz.attachment.sight_pk06_rifle.desc: PK06 rised. White dot the moment you lift.
tacz.attachment.sight_rmr_dot.desc: RMR mini red dot. Small enough to forget it is there.
tacz.attachment.sight_sro_dot.desc: SRO mini red dot. Generous window for its size.
tacz.attachment.sight_srs_02.desc: Trijicon SRS-02 reflex. Square window, honest glass.
tacz.attachment.sight_t1.desc: T1 red dot. Closed tube keeps your lens safe.
tacz.attachment.sight_t2.desc: T2 red dot. Fewer problems, a steeper price.
tacz.attachment.sight_uh1.desc: UH-1 HCOG. Solid picture, solid weight.
tacz.attachment.sniper_extended_mag_1.de: Sniper magazine. One tier of extra rounds.
tacz.attachment.sniper_extended_mag_2.de: Sniper magazine. More rounds, weight follows.
tacz.attachment.sniper_extended_mag_3.de: Sniper magazine. Most rounds, slowest draw.
tacz.attachment.stock_ak12.desc: AK-12 regular stock. Holds pitch and yaw together.
tacz.attachment.stock_carbon_bone_c5.des: Carbon bone frame. Light, fast, mild recoil control.
tacz.attachment.stock_heavy_spas_12.desc: Franchi heavy stock. Built for big shotgun recoil.
tacz.attachment.stock_hk_slim_line.desc: Slim line stock. Steady, reliable recoil control.
tacz.attachment.stock_m4ss.desc: Adjustable tactical stock. Slight horizontal drift.
tacz.attachment.stock_militech_b5.desc: Militech B5. Excellent recoil control, slower handling.
tacz.attachment.stock_moe.desc: Magpul MOE. Fastest draw, mild vertical recoil control.
tacz.attachment.stock_ripstock.desc: CMMG RipStock. Extremely fast draw, mild stability trade.
tacz.attachment.stock_sba3.desc: Compact stock. Tighter spread, easier to carry.
tacz.attachment.stock_tactical_ar.desc: Magpul CTR. Balanced recoil control, nothing fancy.
tacz.attachment.stock_tactical_spas_12.d: Franchi tactical stock. Recoil and spread together.
